description: M7 parity G — young LOW-vuln (age 28), global equity ETF. R2 fails (4>3), R3 fails (2<5), score=65 CONDITIONAL. Paired with scenario 122.
client_narrative: Kofi Asante is 28 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 25,000 euros (around 2,083 euros per month). They hold 55,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 12,000 euros with a 2-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is very conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 1 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 12,000 euros invested.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
